summary: Transform your leadership approach in oil and gas with our Emotional Intelligence training. Boost team dynamics and decision-making for lasting impact.
lede: Emotional Intelligence for Oil and Gas Leaders helps you stay composed under pressure, recognise emotional triggers, and respond more effectively in high-risk operating environments. You will learn how emotions influence behaviour, team morale, risk-taking, and safety culture. Develop practical skills for active listening, trust-building, conflict management, difficult conversations, and leading through change and uncertainty. The course supports leaders across operations, HSE, maintenance, projects, and corporate teams who need to influence behaviour and keep people focused every day.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for leaders and professionals in the oil and gas sector who lead teams in high-risk and high-pressure environments. It is ideal for those who want to enhance their leadership skills and improve safety and performance through the application of emotional intelligence.
audience: Operations managers and supervisors in upstream, midstream
HSE managers, advisors, and safety leaders
Shift team leaders and control room supervisors
Technical team leads and discipline engineers
modules: Foundations of Emotional Intelligence for Oil and Gas Leaders
Empathy and Listening in Technical Environments
Leading Diverse, Multi-Cultural and Multi-Discipline Teams
Influencing Without Authority in Oil and Gas
Leading Change and Transition with Emotional Intelligence
prerequisites: Participants should have a minimum of 3-5 years of leadership experience in the oil and gas industry. Familiarity with basic leadership and management principles is recommended.
